summary: Iron County, WI tower on the Wimple property; a 1941 report describes a foundation and a planned 73-foot height. Listed as gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: The Conservation department finished the concrete foundation for a tower being erected on the Wimple property; the planned height was 73 feet

evidence.supports: Conservation department finished the foundation for a tower on the Wimple property, planned 73 feet high
evidence.quote: The Conservation department has completed the cement foundation of a fire tower being erected on the Wimple property on what is known as the old Wimple road; the tower will be 73 feet high.

evidence.supports: item attributed to the Rhinelander Daily News

corrections.why: 44N is the first part of the page's location label 44N-3E-28, a township, range and section code. It is not an agency; the only agency named on the page is the Conservation department in the 1941 item.

notes_for_editor: The 1941 item is the only tower-specific text, and the link between it and this tower rests on the Central US Lookouts page alone. The 73-foot figure is the 1941 plan, not a measured height, so no height_m is set. The brief's agency '44N' is a location label (see corrections). Fact-check 2026-10-10: the Rhinelander Daily News attribution is printed on the Central US Lookouts page, and a full-page read confirmed the Conservation department is named only in the 1941 item. No new photos found. Used two web searches.
